csharpCode: using UnityEngine; using System.Collections.Generic; public class CheckRoad2002 { public static string Run() { var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder(); var roadLamps = GameObject.Find("Road Lamps"); if (roadLamps == null) return "no lamps"; float minX = float.MaxValue, maxX = float.MinValue, minZ = float.MaxValue, maxZ = float.MinValue; int count = 0; float sumX = 0, sumZ = 0; foreach (Transform t in roadLamps.transform) { if (!t.name.Contains("Road2002")) continue; count++; Vector3 p = t.position; sumX += p.x; sumZ += p.z; if (p.x < minX) minX = p.x; if (p.x > maxX) maxX = p.x; if (p.z < minZ) minZ = p.z; if (p.z > maxZ) maxZ = p.z; if (count <= 3) sb.AppendLine(t.name.Substring(0,7) + "... " + p); } if (count == 0) return "no Road2002 lamps"; float avgZ = sumZ / count; float halfSpan = (maxZ - minZ) / 2f; sb.AppendLine("count=" + count + " avgZ=" + avgZ.ToString("F2") + " halfSpan=" + halfSpan.ToString("F2")); sb.AppendLine("z range: " + minZ.ToString("F2") + " to " + maxZ.ToString("F2")); return sb.ToString(); } }
